pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: Download spec file, record SHA-256, index in spec-index.yaml, require T3 authorization
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: acquire_spec.py works correctly but requires T3 authorization which has only been completed for ODF formats
pipeline_stages.authority_output_passed_forward: spec-index.yaml with source_hash and provenance metadata
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Yes — DRY-RUN mode by default; --allow-network requires explicit flag
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: Can be bypassed by manually creating spec-index.yaml with fake metadata
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Complete T3 for CSV, TOML, QOI, NDJSON. Register acquire-spec-t3 as governed skill.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: refresh_check.py scans spec-index.yaml entries and flags stale/missing/hash-mismatch
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: Works correctly. 4 stale entries found: fodt/1.3, odf-shared/1.3 (parts 1,2,4) — missing files.
pipeline_stages.authority_output_passed_forward: Staleness report (no downstream consumer in production pipeline)
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Returns exit 1 if stale; called as advisory (no-blocking) from autonomous_cycle.py Step 0a-refresh
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: Advisory-only — stale entries do not block product sprints
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Re-acquire stale FODT and ODF-shared spec files. Upgrade staleness check to blocking for formats used in active product sprints.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: spec_normalizer.py extracts text, sections, chunks, page map from cached spec
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: Fully functional for FODS (text.txt, sections.jsonl, chunks.jsonl, page-map.yaml). NOT run for CSV, TOML, QOI, NDJSON, XCF, PBM/PGM/PPM.
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Fails if no cached spec. Cannot proceed without spec file.
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: Blocked by missing spec file — not a bypass, a genuine upstream dependency
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: After T3 completion, run normalization for CSV/TOML/QOI. Register normalize-spec as governed skill.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: run_extraction_pipeline.py extracts verified facts from normalized spec artifacts
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: Run for FODS (4988 facts), FODT (4936 facts), ODF family. NOT run for non-ODF formats.
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Requires normalized artifacts. Cannot extract facts from metadata-only cache.
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: Can manually add structural facts to verified-facts-review.yaml without running pipeline
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: After normalization, run extraction for CSV/TOML/QOI. Register extract-spec-facts as governed skill.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: spec_verifier.py validates facts via deterministic spec text search or independent agent verification
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: Verification was done for FODS (4348 verified) via independent_agent_verifier. 640 FODS facts remain unverified. Most other formats have only structural/accepted facts from workbench.
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Verification pipeline requires deterministic method — cannot self-certify as verified
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: AI-extracted facts can be marked verified if validation_ai_fact_guard is advisory (it is)
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Upgrade Step 2d4 AI fact guard from advisory to blocking for PRODUCT_SOURCE items.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: build_requirement_pack.py generates requirement packs from verified facts for specific product tasks
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: tools/spec-normalize/build_requirement_pack.py exists. Requirement packs exist in .local/spec-cache/fods/1.3/workbench/requirement-packs/. NOT integrated into product task generation.
pipeline_stages.authority_output_passed_forward: Requirement pack YAML files (consumed by? — unknown, likely manual)
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: Complete bypass — requirement packs are never consumed by product task selector or prompt generator
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Wire requirement pack output into generate_next_worker_prompt.py. Add requirement_pack_ref to worker prompts.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: select_poc_gaps.py selects gaps from gap-ledger.json that are appropriate for next sprint
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: Works. Reads gap-ledger.json and filters by stream/format. Does NOT check authority level before selecting gaps for product work.
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Does not fail on missing spec authority
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: Gap selection is authority-agnostic — gaps for P1 formats are selectable
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Add authority gate check to select_poc_gaps.py: skip gaps for formats at P<4 without exception_classification.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: product_task_selector.py emits bounded, safe product tasks with authority gate validation
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: _get_format_authority_status() returns ALLOWED for any poc-targets-registered format. Hard-coded task catalog for Gnumeric/ABW bypasses actual P-level. _BLOCKED_AUTHORITY_STATES never populated from actual P-level.
pipeline_stages.authority_output_passed_forward: Task dict with format, action, target_file
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Returns BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_AUTHORITY for unregistered formats only
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: CRITICAL BYPASS: any poc-targets-registered format gets tasks regardless of P-level
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Replace poc-targets membership check with authority_gate_validation P-level check.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: generate_next_worker_prompt.py injects spec authority data (facts, requirement packs, authority level) into worker prompts
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: READ_BEFORE_EXECUTION includes poc-targets.yaml, gap-ledger, skill-registry but NOT spec cache artifacts. Workers receive no FACT-* IDs, no requirement packs, no spec sections.
pipeline_stages.authority_output_passed_forward: Worker prompt text (without spec authority data)
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Does not fail on missing spec authority
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: Complete bypass — prompts carry no spec authority
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Add spec authority section to worker prompt injection.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: action_queue.py schedules tasks based on authority-validated gap selection
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: action_queue.py exists. Authority level not a scheduling criterion. Queue actions don't require spec fact refs.
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Does not fail on missing spec authority
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Add authority_level field to queued action items. Block execution of product tasks for P<4 formats without exception.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: Block PRODUCT_SOURCE/TEST items with no gap_ledger_ref, capability_ref, AND no spec_fact_refs
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: Blocks if ALL THREE are absent. gap_ledger_ref alone bypasses spec_fact_refs requirement. This is a gap_ledger_ref-or-spec_fact_refs gate, not an AND gate.
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: CRITICAL BYPASS: gap_ledger_ref alone passes the gate
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Change OR to AND: require BOTH gap_ledger_ref AND spec_fact_refs (or exception_classification).

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: Governance validator V13 blocks PRODUCT_SOURCE/READINESS/RELEASE_GATE items without spec_fact_refs or valid exception
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: V13 blocks when spec_fact_refs is provided but invalid. When spec_fact_refs is ABSENT (None/missing), V13 does NOT fire unless declaration has no exception_classification. Most declarations have exception_classification or absent spec_fact_refs without explicit exception.
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: Bypass via absent spec_fact_refs (V13 doesn't fire). Bypass via exception_classification.
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Require spec_fact_refs to be PRESENT (not None) for PRODUCT_SOURCE items without exception_classification. V13 should fire when spec_fact_refs is absent AND exception_classification is absent.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: 19 detectors check for evidence quality issues including spec authority (Detectors 17 and 19)
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: Detector 17 (stream-local authority) checks for file existence. Detector 19 (ODF spec linkage) checks ODF PRODUCT_SOURCE items for missing spec_qname_refs and spec_fact_refs — HIGH severity, downgrades verdict but does NOT block. Other detectors check paths and content but not spec authority.
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Only critical severity blocks continuation. HIGH severity downgrades verdict.
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: Detector 19 is HIGH (not critical) — downgrades but doesn't block. Detector 17 is MEDIUM — informational.
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Upgrade Detector 19 from HIGH to CRITICAL for ODF formats in product sprints. Add Detector 20: non-ODF PRODUCT_SOURCE items without exception_classification fail.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: Proof graph validates spec→fact→code→test→evidence chain for each format
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: Proof graphs exist for FODS FACT-001 and ZST FACT-001 only. build_proof_graph_iter003.py exists but proof graphs for ODS/ODT/FODG/FODP/FODT are absent. Product ledger does not record authority level.
pipeline_stages.authority_input_required: Workbench verified facts, code citation data, test citation data
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: No — proof graph absence doesn't block anything
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: Proof graph is not a blocking gate. Formats with P5 citations but no proof graph are not blocked.
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Create proof graphs for all P5+ formats. Make proof graph presence a requirement for P6 claim.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: Generate authority-integration-contract.json at sprint start; run overclaim_detector; validate mainstream gap queue
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: authority_integration_fabric.py is NOT imported or called from any production path. tools/requirements_authority/ (graph_store, coverage_evaluator, overclaim_detector) are also dormant.
pipeline_stages.authority_input_required: Would need: spec artifacts, gap queue, POC targets
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: Complete bypass — the integration fabric never runs
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Wire into autonomous_cycle.py Step 0. Add as mandatory pre-sprint authority state computation.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: check_continuation.py verifies authority readiness before returning CONTINUE
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: check_continuation.py checks: session ID match, plan lock status, iteration count, approval gates. Does NOT check authority level for target format.
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Stops for session mismatch, plan lock, exceeded iterations
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Add advisory authority readiness check: warn if target format is P<4 without exception.

pipeline_stages.expected_behavior: Supervisor grades work items and rejects items without spec authority citations
pipeline_stages.actual_behavior: Supervisor grades using governance validators (including V13) and LLM quality scorer. V13 blocks for ODF items without spec_fact_refs. Gap_ledger_ref items pass V13 bypass. Sprint can be ACCEPTED with zero spec authority citations via gap_ledger_ref path.
pipeline_stages.fail_closed_behavior: Blocks for multiple governance violations. But gap_ledger_ref bypass allows acceptance.
pipeline_stages.bypass_behavior: CRITICAL BYPASS: gap_ledger_ref alone allows ACCEPTED verdict with zero spec citations
pipeline_stages.repair_strategy: Close gap_ledger_ref bypass in TC-GUARD-001 AND require spec_fact_refs in evidence schema.
